description: This file implements a React hook 'useAutoUpdater' and related store logic for managing application update status within the Notesnook project. It handles update checking, progress, and status updates via event subscriptions.

classes.name: AutoUpdateStore
classes.description: A store class extending BaseStore to hold and update the current update status.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current update status in the store.

methods.name: useAutoUpdater
methods.description: React hook that manages update status by subscribing to update events and providing the current status.
